label: oracle exact-three-line development/mechanism diagnostic with official cumulative expansion budget restored

population.selection_note: Reference-selected exact-three-nonempty-newline-terminated physical-line population; generation receives only sanitized fields.

cycle5_diagnostic.role: post-hoc mechanism falsification diagnostic; not independent performance evidence

official_expand_budget_source.preselection_mask: Before entropy/proposal/position selection, expansion logit is blocked when cur_generation_window_length == max_tokens or expand_budget == 0.
official_expand_budget_source.successful_expand_decrement: After a selected expand token is replaced by two masks, num_generation_tokens increases by one and expand_budget decreases by one.
official_expand_budget_source.local_semantics: One global per-sample cumulative budget shared across all three sequential slots; no reset and no refund on deletion. No other official config difference is imported.

tokenizer.newline_token_definition: Every tokenizer ID whose single-token decode contains newline or carriage return.
tokenizer.mapping_normalization: Replace CRLF and bare CR with LF; split at first LF; retokenize and strict-round-trip left text.
tokenizer.generation_lookup: One vocabulary scan at tokenizer initialization followed by O(1) token-ID lookup.

generation.attention: All real prefix, completed/current/future slots, locked separators, and suffix participate in every full forward; only right padding is hidden.
generation.selection: Only unresolved masks in the sequentially active hard slot are eligible; one position is selected by largest negative-entropy confidence.
generation.completion: Direct region/token extraction with locked separators; no post-hoc truncation, repair, retry, or fallback.

decoder_revision.newline_boundary: Unchanged from V2-Hard-v2 online first-newline boundary action.
decoder_revision.region_local_eos: Unchanged from V2-Hard-v2 local unresolved-mask broadcast deletion.

expand_budget.zero_budget_action: Set eligible expand vocabulary logits to -inf before top-p, entropy confidence, proposal, and position selection.

cycle_detection.budget_draining_loop: Repeated canvas transition with strictly lower pre/post remaining budget is diagnostic only and does not terminate.
cycle_detection.exact_deterministic_cycle: Only the second occurrence of the same complete transition at the same full budgeted state is terminal.

resume.durability: Atomic/durable append after each complete row.

failure_policy.forward_cap_with_unresolved_masks: controlled terminal method failure; empty completion; included in denominator
failure_policy.exact_deterministic_cycle: controlled terminal method failure; empty completion; included in denominator
failure_policy.runtime_or_invariant_damage: engineering gate failure and immediate stop

diagnostics.discard_reference_analysis: Oracle mechanism diagnostic performed only after generation.
